verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a unified `.forget` deletion operation supporting single data item deletion, entire dataset (per-entity/graph) deletion, and full cleanup ('remove everything the current user can delete'), directly matching the platform-engineer's need for granular-to-full erasure. Combined with dataset-scoped permissions/multi-user isolation, this supports privacy-driven per-user deletion workflows. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of deletion completeness or audit-trail evidence for compliance (e.g., GDPR-style confirmation), and no explicit per-single-memory (vs per-data-item) deletion example.
